Title: Azure Memory metric available for Power BI Embedded

Body.Content:
The new Azure Memory metric is available for Power BI Embedded.

This metric shows the usage of memory in your resource. The units are in gigabytes, so you can track exactly how much of your RAM is being used every minute.
